db_driver.description: Database backend to use: SQLite, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.

db_path.description: Path to the SQLite database file (used only when DbDriver=SQLite).

db_port.description: Database server port (PostgreSQL default: 5432, MySQL default: 3306).

db_name.description: Name of the database to use (PostgreSQL/MySQL).

daemon.description: Whether to run Quassel Core as a background daemon.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for daemon mode.

host.description: IP address or hostname to bind the client listening port to.

port.description: TCP port for incoming client connections.

use_ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS for client connections (recommended for remote access).

ssl_cert.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (required if UseSSL=true).

ssl_key.description: Path to the SSL private key file (required if UseSSL=true).

max_buffer_count.description: Maximum number of backlog lines to keep per channel/query (0 = unlimited).

max_buffered_bytes.description: Maximum total bytes to store per buffer (0 = unlimited).

allow_remote.description: Allow clients to connect from remote hosts (set to false for local-only).

idle_timeout.description: Idle connection timeout in seconds (0 = no timeout).
